models_evaluated: FDA-approved deep learning model for intracranial hemorrhage detection

links.outcome: Local external validation of ICH detection model against radiologist reference standard
links.effect: Sensitivity 89%, specificity 96%, PPV 82%, NPV 97%, accuracy 94%, AUC 0.954 on 5600 local CT scans.
links.quote: The model exhibited outstanding performance, achieving a high sensitivity of 89% and specificity of 96%.

unlisted_practices: Analysis of patient risk factors (age, sex, trauma history, hypertension, smoking) influencing model performance

screen.reason: Prospective external validation of an FDA-approved deep learning model for intracranial hemorrhage detection on 5,600 non-contrast CT scans, including clinician satisfaction surveys and risk factor subgroup analysis.
